performance_sharpe: LS mean/sample SD; funded excess over RF equals LS; Fund X uses its return minus RF
zero_h: mean of the actual diagnostic series divided by its sample SD
factor_regression: FF3 US; dependent LS directly, funded minus RF=LS, Fund X minus RF
primary_quintiles: Original spread series sorted by common-history excess Sharpe, Q1 low/Q5 high,39 each; alphabetical exact tie break
quintile_intervals: Point frequencies only; strategies share stocks and calendar observations

ridge_logit.standardization: Cross-strategy mean and sample SD recomputed in each fit
ridge_logit.uncertainty: Joint circular calendar-block bootstrap; same calendar indices for all195 strategies, representations, weightings and RF
ridge_logit.interpretation: Descriptive same-history association, not a causal or independent cross-sectional model
ridge_logit.percentile_range: Conditional calendar-block refit range; rare threshold events can put the point estimate outside the percentile range
